Hi @martin.r.mathieson, thank you for your detailed feedback! I've made changes based of your comments and pushed the changes. Please review whenever you can.

I've attached the following captures:
- A Silabs DCH capture from an adapter running an OpenThread image. (use ieee802154 thread hash decryption key - `00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff`)
- A Silabs DCH capture from an adapter running a zigbee image:
    * in Zigbee protocol add nwk key - `F6:01:21:73:96:D5:DE:72:91:A4:74:14:11:D3:05:DB`
    * in Zigbee protocol add link key - `D0 D1 D2 D3 D4 D5 D6 D7 D8 D9 DA DB DC DD DE DF`
    * add following display filter to see most relevant packets - `wpan.dst16 == 0x0000 || wpan.dst16 == 0xc79c`
- A Silabs DCH Capture with a message type that is not supported yet

Please let me know if you need anything else!



[open_thread.pcapng](/uploads/194e9eb6a5d011ca2ac2a91adb35bc48/open_thread.pcapng)

[unsupported_type_sample.pcapng](/uploads/33a6f8e2c62b7495138fe384e0d618c5/unsupported_type_sample.pcapng)

[zigbee.pcapng](/uploads/b7442772573731e07d7d548baa594457/zigbee.pcapng)
Thanks, will try these out (most likely tomorrow now).
Have done some fuzzing, didn't see anything.  In any case, there are no loops, or array lookups, or divisions...
Thank you!
We insert these into alphabetical order.
